title: 第三十章    功法
content_zh:
“湘儿，你说，我卡在**境后期巅峰已经数月之久了，体内的星力越发的充实，并且还有着外溢的现象，可我为什么不能迟迟踏出那最后一步呢？”

    “嗯？要不我去给你弄一颗玄极丹给你，虽说价格有点贵，我应该可以做得到的。”蓝湘轻声道，她知道琼霄从山村里出来的，可能没有玄极丹这种贵重的丹药！

    听后，琼霄心中很感动，有此女在身边，夫复何求呢！“不用，湘儿，玄极丹我有，地星丹我也有，天元丹我也有，而且星辰丹我也有一颗！给你看！”说着琼霄随手一翻，手中出现了几个药瓶，“湘儿！你看！”

    蓝湘给琼霄大大的震撼了一把，这些丹药的出现，使得周围的天地能力有了一些异动！

    “赶紧收起来，别让他人看到了！”蓝湘赶紧催促道。琼霄微微一笑，将丹药收了起来。

    “你怎么得到这些丹药的，这些丹药价格不菲啊！”蓝湘好奇的问道。

    “呵呵，这是我在进入学院前到深山之中苦修时得到的！”琼霄解释道。

    “就这么简单？”

    “就这么简单！”

    “看来你对我不是真心，都连句实话都没有！”蓝湘委屈道。

    “湘儿……不是我不想告诉你，我是怕你担心！”琼霄解释道。

    “那更加要告诉我了！”蓝湘嗔怒道。

    “好，我告诉你，那要从我十四岁那时说起……”

    就这样，琼霄将他如何进入死亡山脉，然后如何被人陷害进入绝境，生死存亡之间，得到这些丹药，而后被人追杀，坠入山崖，与魔兽相斗……

    听了琼霄的经历，蓝湘眼眶不禁湿润起来，她没想到，她所喜欢的男子，居然会有着如此的经历，虽然琼霄故意把其中的危险稍微淡化修饰了一番，但她可以感觉的到，这其中的危险。

    “这些年苦了你了！”蓝湘小手抚摸着琼霄的脸庞，琼霄能感受的道蓝湘那真挚的情感。

    “苦倒没有，只有常年处于生死搏杀的状态，实力才能更快的突破！正如院长所说的：强者的道路没有坦途！”琼霄微笑道。

    “以后我陪在你的身边，不管你去哪里，我都要站在你身旁！”

    “好好，不管以后去哪里我都带着你！”琼霄平静的说道。

    “嗯，那就好，还有，你有了玄极丹，怎么不试着突破？”

    “我也想试试，可不知道怎么一回事，我总觉得突破不了，是不是我修炼的方法不对，还是怎么一回事！”

    “修炼方法？我知道你的武学很强大，可你修炼的功法是什么，我很好奇，你怎么能施展这么强大的武学的？”蓝湘好奇的问道。

    “功法？什么是功法？我在山洞之中只得到一部武学，其他的武学，都是我抢来的，难道，武学不等于功法吗？”琼霄挠头道。

    “变态！你居然没有修炼任何功法，居然还能修炼到**境后期巅峰！你是怎么修炼的？体内的星力居然能够支持你施展如此强大的攻击！”听的琼霄解释，蓝湘坐起身子，紧盯着琼霄，道。

    “额，我就是这么修炼的！没有人和我说过，修炼还要有功法才行啊！。”

    “怪不得，你会卡在**境巅峰，要是修炼星力，如果没有功法，能够突破到化星境界就已经不错了，你居然能达到**境后期巅峰，我很好奇，你是怎么做到的！”

    “可能是长期处于生死搏斗中，使得身体有了更加强大的支持力吧！”

    “呃呃……”

    “好了，不说这个了，湘儿你的意思是说我欠缺一部修炼功法？”
content_en:
"Xian'er, tell me, I've been stuck at the peak of the late stage of the ** realm for several months. The star power in my body is becoming more and more abundant, and there is still overflow, but why can't I take that last step?"

"Huh? How about I get you a Xuanji Pill. Although the price is a bit expensive, I should be able to do it." Lan Xiang said softly. She knew that Qiong Xiao came from a mountain village and might not have such a precious pill as Xuanji Pill!

After hearing this, Qiong Xiao was very moved. With this woman by his side, what more could a husband ask for!"No, Xiang'er, I have the Xuanji Pill, I have the Earth Star Pill, I have the Tianyuan Pill, and I also have one of the Star Pills! Let me show you!" Qiong Xiao flipped through it, and several medicine bottles appeared in his hand, "Xiang'er! Look!"

Lan Xiang was greatly shocked by Qiong Xiao. The appearance of these pills caused some changes in the surrounding world's abilities!

"Put it away quickly, don't let others see it!" Lan Xiang urged quickly.Qiong Xiao smiled slightly and put away the elixir.

"How did you get these pills? These pills are expensive!" Lan Xiang asked curiously.

"Haha, I got this when I went to the mountains to practice hard before entering the academy!" Qiong Xiao explained.

"Is it that simple?"

"It's that simple!"

"It seems that you are not sincere to me, and you can't even tell the truth!" Lan Xiang said aggrievedly.

"Xiang'er...it's not that I don't want to tell you, I'm afraid you'll be worried!" Qiong Xiao explained.

"Then you have to tell me even more!" Lan Xiang said angrily.

"Okay, let me tell you, it started when I was fourteen years old..."

In this way, Qiong Xiao told how he entered the Death Mountain, and then how he was framed into a desperate situation. Between life and death, he obtained these pills, and then was chased by others, fell into the cliff, and fought with monsters...

After hearing Qiong Xiao's experience, Lan Xiang's eyes couldn't help but moisten. She didn't expect that the man she liked would have such an experience. Although Qiong Xiao deliberately downplayed the danger, she could feel the danger.

"I've suffered so much for you these years!" Lan Xiang stroked Qiong Xiao's face with his little hand, and Qiong Xiao could feel Lan Xiang's sincere emotions.

"It's not hard. Only by being in a life-and-death struggle all year round can your strength break through faster! As the dean said: There is no smooth road for the strong!" Qiong Xiao said with a smile.

"I will stay by your side from now on. No matter where you go, I will stand by your side!"

"Okay, no matter where I go from now on, I will take you with me!" Qiong Xiao said calmly.

"Well, that's good. Also, you have the Xuanji Pill, why don't you try to break through?"

"I want to try it too, but I don't know what's going on. I always feel like I can't make a breakthrough. Is my cultivation method wrong or something?"

"Cultivation method? I know your martial arts is very powerful, but what kind of martial arts do you practice? I am very curious, how can you use such powerful martial arts?" Lan Xiang asked curiously.

"Gong Technique? What is a Kung Fu Technique? I only got one martial art in the cave, and I snatched the other martial arts. Isn't martial arts equal to Kung Fu Technique?" Qiong Xiao scratched her head.

"Abnormal! You haven't practiced any skills, and you can still practice to the peak of the late stage of the ** realm! How did you practice? The star power in your body can actually support you to carry out such a powerful attack!" After hearing Qiong Xiao's explanation, Lan Xiang sat up and stared at Qiong Xiao, saying.

"Uh, that's how I practice! No one has ever told me that practicing requires skills!"

"No wonder you are stuck at the peak of the ** realm. If you practice star power, without the skills, it would be good to be able to break through to the star transformation realm. You can actually reach the peak of the late ** realm. I am very curious about how you did it!"

"Maybe it's because of being in a life-and-death struggle for a long time that the body has stronger support!"

"Uh uh..."

"Okay, let's not talk about this anymore. Xiang'er, do you mean that I lack a cultivation technique?"
